Product engineer 
 Orion Township, MI
 

 EXP 2-5 yrs
 DEG Bach
 RELO
 BONUS
 TRAVEL
 

 Job Description
 

 Design, develop, validate, and launch fuel pumps, fuel delivery modules, and fuel delivery systems for on-road & off-road to customers.
 Interpret customer specifications to develop component level requirements.
 Prepare engineering bill of materials and print packages for quoting.
 Lead product design activities from concept through launch.
 Create DFMEA and execute DVPR.
 Professionally represent us to customers and suppliers.
 Work with purchasing team to identify, develop, and manage prototype & production component suppliers.
 

 Skills and certifications
 engineering degree 
 product engineer is specific title 
 automotive would be nice--not required 
 Ideal candidate
 High energy individuals who can design, develop, validate, and launch fuel pumps, fuel delivery modules, and fuel delivery systems for on-road & off-road customers. This candidate will be able to work self-sufficiently and work with people external to engineering office. Main plant travel will be Ohio and southern IL. Need a real go getter.
 Ideal candidate should have worked for the following company(ies): 
 Automotive is best. Even new grads are acceptable. Open to hard working, motivated individuals.
 

 

 



 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

 Direct Staffing Inc
